edit.description: the `files` prediction section states what siblings cut from one section owe each other

summary: Two entries cut from one spec section share that section's seam and neither declares it, so the partition runs them together and the loser's whole span is discarded
acceptance: the plan discipline tells a slice cutting one section into siblings to declare the shared seam on each or chain them with `blockedBy`, so the partition serializes what the section couples
notes: Measured twice on 2026-09-24: A-CLAIM-HOLDS-AN-ENTRY-IN-FLIGHT against the refusal entry (`src/selection.ts`, `src/waveTick.ts`), then A-CONTINUATION-ROUTES-BACK-TO-BUILD against A-COMPLETED-ENTRY-TAKES-ITS-CONTINUING-NOTE-WITH-IT (`harness/chain.ts`, `harness/judgeGate.ts`, `harness/putDown.ts`). Each cost the losing agent's span and a quarantine. Not an engine change: the partition did what its inputs said. The prediction is honest per entry and wrong per pair.
